title: English Teacher & Freelance IT Technician
summary: Taught English from beginner to advanced levels, and in parallel worked as a freelance IT technician for my own clients, focused on troubleshooting and systems support.
highlights: Planned lessons and assessments for individuals and groups, using debates, role-play and multimedia to improve retention.
Gave regular evaluations and personalized feedback.
Diagnosed and fixed hardware, software and network problems for freelance clients, and kept their systems running.
growth: Teaching made me good at explaining complex things simply; support work taught me to debug methodically under real-world pressure.
